abilities.name: Replacement
abilities.printedText: Reattach 1 cheer from your stage to 1 of your holomem.

abilities.name: So, that Makes You My Enemy?
abilities.printedText: Swap your opponent's center holomem with 1 back holomem. During this turn, your white center holomem gets Arts +50.

abilities.name: A Map in My Left Hand
abilities.printedText: Usable if your holomem's ability would roll a die: Declare 1 face number; the next result is treated as the declared result.

abilities.name: A Mic in My Right Hand
abilities.printedText: Send any number of cheers from your archive to 1 of your green holomem.

abilities.name: Unlimited Tokino Sora
abilities.printedText: You may include any number of this holomem in the deck.

abilities.name: Unlimited AZKi
abilities.printedText: You may include any number of this holomem in the deck.

abilities.name: Let's Dance!
abilities.printedText: During this turn, your center holomem gets Arts +20.

arts.name: Your Heart… Will Turn from Cloudy to Sunny!

abilities.name: Buzz Life Loss
abilities.printedText: If this holomem is downed, you get Life-2.

arts.name: SorAZ Sympathy
arts.printedText: If an AZKi holomem is on your stage, Arts +50.

abilities.name: HOPE
abilities.printedText: Look at your holo Power. Reveal 1 card from among them, and add it to hand. Then, put 1 card from your hand as holo Power.

abilities.name: Expanding Map
abilities.printedText: You may roll a die once: If it is 4 or less, send the top card of your cheer deck to your back holomem. Then, if it is 1, you may move this holomem to the back position.

arts.name: A Journey with No Destination with You
SorAZ Gravity
arts.printedText: If a Tokino Sora holomem is on your stage, send the top card of your cheer deck to your holomem.

arts.name: Destiny Song
arts.printedText: You may roll a die once: If it is odd, this Arts gets +50. Then, if it is 1, this Arts gets +50.

abilities.name: Drawing Together!
abilities.printedText: You may send 1 white cheer or green cheer from your archive to your center holomem.

abilities.name: Additional Names
abilities.printedText: This holomem is also regarded as Tokino Sora and AZKi.

arts.name: A Future I Want to Surpass
arts.printedText: You may roll a die once: If it is odd, send the top card of your cheer deck to this holomem. If it is even, draw 1 card from your deck.

abilities.name: Cannot Bloom
abilities.printedText: This holomem cannot Bloom.

abilities.name: SoAzKo
abilities.printedText: If collab with Tokino Sora, draw 1 card from your deck. If collab with AZKi, send the top card of your cheer deck to your center holomem.

abilities.name: Cannot Bloom
abilities.printedText: This holomem cannot Bloom.

abilities.name: Normal PC
abilities.printedText: Reveal 1 Debut holomem from your deck, and place it on Stage. Then, shuffle the deck.

abilities.name: Harusaki Nodoka
abilities.printedText: Draw 3 cards from your deck.

abilities.name: Manager-chan
abilities.printedText: This card can only be used if you have 1 or more cards in hand excluding this card. Return all of the cards in your hand to the deck and shuffle it. Then, draw 5 cards from your deck.

abilities.name: Sub PC
abilities.printedText: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Reveal 1 Limited support card from among them, and add it to hand. Then, return the rest to the bottom of the deck in any order.

abilities.name: Amazing PC
abilities.printedText: This card can only be used if you archive 1 cheer from your stage. Reveal 1 1st holomem or 2nd holomem other than Buzz from your deck, and add it to hand. Then, shuffle the deck.

abilities.name: Circle of hololive Listeners
abilities.printedText: Roll a die once: If it is 3 or greater, send 1 cheer from your archive to your holomem.

abilities.name: First Gravity
abilities.printedText: This card can only be used if you have 6 or less cards in hand excluding this card. Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Reveal any number of Tokino Sora and/or AZKi from among them, and put the revealed holomem into hand. Then, return the rest to the bottom of the deck in any order.

abilities.name: Cheer rules reminder
abilities.printedText: If a holomem leaves the stage, archive all of that holomem's cheers. If a holomem Baton Passes, archive the specified number of that holomem's cheers.
